format: XAVC HS 4K (HEVC), XAVC S 4K (AVC) and XAVC S-I 4K (AVC intra)

parts.builder: XAVC HS 4K / XAVC S 4K at 23.98p and 25p, normal speed: the descriptors our builder changes
parts.hevc8: HEVC 4:2:0 8-bit rows at 23.98p and 25p (no menu format of this camera that we know of)
parts.p50: 50p (coding-rate code 1), normal speed: HEVC, AVC and S-I; the one-core long-GOP rows are made two-core
parts.s_i: XAVC S-I 4K (codec 0x18) at 23.98p and 25p, normal speed (both the UseCore 2 rows and their UseCore 0 twins)
parts.sq120: rows with input rate 120 (slow and quick recording at 100/120 frames a second coded as 23.98p, 25p or 50p)
